name: น้องปิ่นโต
description: Pinto, a cheerful Thai girl about 6 years old: short black bob with straight bangs, round face, pink dash blush. Outfit: yellow short-sleeve shirt with small pink hearts, pink shorts, white socks, red sneakers.

name: เพื่อน
description: Pinto's best friend, a Thai boy about 6 years old: short messy black hair, round face, pink dash blush. Outfit: light blue T-shirt with a white star, dark green shorts, white socks, yellow sneakers.

name: แม่
description: Pinto's mother, a kind Thai woman in her early thirties: shoulder-length black hair tied in a low ponytail, round face, pink dash blush. Outfit: soft green short-sleeve blouse, long beige skirt, simple brown flat shoes.

name: แมวดำ
description: Pinto's small round black house cat: short black fur, small pink nose, pink blush, a red scarf tied at the neck.

name: ห้องนอนของปิ่นโต
description: Pinto's bedroom: a small single wooden bed with a yellow blanket with small pink hearts and a white pillow, light pink walls, a white window with sky-blue curtains, a small wooden desk with a round lamp, a round blue rug, a low white shelf with picture books and a brown teddy bear.

name: ห้องนั่งเล่น
description: the family living room: a soft sky-blue sofa with two yellow cushions, a low round light-wood coffee table, cream walls, a big window with mint-green curtains, a green potted plant in a white pot, a striped pastel rug, a low wooden TV cabinet.

name: ห้องน้ำ
description: the family bathroom: a white sink on a light-wood cabinet, a round mirror above it, light blue wall tiles, a small white step stool, a pink toothbrush cup, a yellow towel on a hook, a striped bath mat. No toilet in view.

name: ห้องกินข้าว
description: the family dining room: one rectangular light-wood dining table with four matching wooden chairs, a small vase of yellow flowers in the middle of the table, cream walls, a round hanging lamp above the table, a window with yellow curtains, a low wooden sideboard.
